item: Row 278: the OSM picker shows the daily change file cost measured here
summary: Q824, 0.6 gate row B. Each chosen country in the Settings OSM picker carries the median compressed size of its applied daily change files (osm_diff_runs.bytes_fetched), how many carried one and the newest file's own date, read in one OSM lane session closed before the picker answers (never opened when the lane file is absent); the cell leads with it and moves the from-memory estimate to the hover. A country without a figure keeps the estimate with the reason in the hover (no lane, no file applied, no measured size, older lane, unreadable), never a 0. The cadence text no longer says the daily apply arrives in 0.6 and the stale apply field is dropped. x12.
